Name: Ashvath
Summary: Son of Japhlet, named among the children of Japhlet.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:33: Son of Japhlet, named among the children of Japhlet.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ashvath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
